## Section Structure & Fidelity Order

1. **Navbar**: Sticky header with logo ("Carousel Orbit") and navigation links.
2. **Hero / Header**: Section header showing "Carousel #2" and "Our Products" title.
3. **Carousel Showcase**: Responsive product cards slider with prev/next controls, displaying picsum product images and sample titles.
4. **Footer**: Clean footer with copyright and mandatory `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock") link.
